name: AWS
summary: On AWS, the agent-specific hosting option is Amazon Bedrock AgentCore: a set of managed services for running agents built with any framework and any model. AgentCore Runtime gives each session its own microVM, and companion services cover memory, an MCP tool gateway, identity, code execution, a cloud browser, payments and OpenTelemetry-based observability. Agents can also run on general AWS compute such as Lambda, ECS or EC2.
facts: Up to 8 hours on microVMs, up to 14 days on Instances
Any (LangGraph, CrewAI, Strands, OpenAI Agents SDK, Claude Agent SDK, custom)
goodFor: Pairing hosting with managed memory, identity and tools
watchOut: More setup than single-command deploy platforms
